Each turn start now records the tofu version; a session from before this gets no note.\n\n### Changed\n\n- `remember` refuses a rule that says the same as one already kept and names it; `replaces <id>` puts the new one in its place and `keep_both` keeps both. Jev decides \"the same\", and a Jev failure never blocks a memory.\n- `recall` takes the id of one of the lead's own tool calls, the id it already sees, as well as a `[tool#…]` reference.\n- Search over folded sub-agents opens a found call from the read it already did: from ctrl+k to the found event it allocates SIZE where rc11 took SIZE.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A session opened in `tofu serve` after another no longer carries the other session's items."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc11","heading":"0.5.15-rc11 - 2026-10-17","body":"Old work is cheap to reach: recall finds a call by its id, and search over hundreds of folded sub-agents stops reading them all.\n\n### Changed\n\n- `recall` given a call's reference, such as `[TOOLREF2]`, returns that call's record, its arguments and its result, from this session or any it was forked from, and says plainly when no call has that id.\n- Search over 450 folded sub-agents builds a label only for what matches and streams the session file instead of parsing it whole: from ctrl+k to the found event it allocates SIZE where it took SIZE.\n- An `ask_person` header holds up to 30 characters, where 12 refused ordinary headers.\n- A sub-agent with no skill tool is told which skills were loaded for it, and a brief naming a skill it cannot load is answered with a note instead of a skill it never gets.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A release commit refuses a docs page that breaks the docs contract, so a page over its length no longer goes out unnoticed."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc10-fix1","heading":"0.5.15-rc10-fix1 - 2026-10-17","body":"### Fixed\n\n- An agent named with `--as` logs, moves and asks on its own ticket again; 0.5.15-rc10 refused `tofu boardy log X --as go-dev` on a ticket assigned to `go-dev`.\n- A session that holds only a cron can be continued from a second terminal before the job first fires, and a window that only listed its jobs no longer shows up in `tofu session list` as an unreadable session.\n- Opening a folded sub-agent's call by its reference opens only that agent: SIZE held where it was SIZE with 450 folded."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc10","heading":"0.5.15-rc10 - 2026-10-17","body":"A long night in one session: crons run where the session is held, the date moves at midnight, and a fork sends your words once.\n\n### Changed\n\n- A fork's episode view leaves out your words the fork already carries, so each is sent once: on a driven fork the view went from 3,N bytes to 1,942. A resume keeps the view it had, so its cache holds, and the fork notice gives the real size after the fork.\n- An `edit` whose text appears once in a file unchanged since it was read is applied even outside the lines read; text that appears twice there, or a file changed since, is still refused.\n- `tofu learn` makes a rule only from corrections that agree within neighbouring clauses, and reads \"again\" as a correction only when it speaks to the lead, so a one-off request no longer becomes a rule.\n- `tofu boardy move` to the status a ticket already has prints that it is already there and exits 0. A name given with `--as` acts as that agent, never as the person, and an `--acceptance` typed without a dash is stored one line per check.\n- Opening one folded sub-agent by search opens only that one: SIZE held where it was SIZE with 450 folded.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A `/loop` or `/cron` made in a fresh terminal runs: it fires in the session's holder instead of failing with \"is open for writing\", and the trace names the process that fired it.\n- The terminal's footer shows a model pick another client made and keeps it, and offers its own default only to a holder with none, so a cron runs on the model the footer shows.\n- The date the lead and its sub-agents are told moves at midnight in a running session, and an expired cron job comes back with `/cron edit c1 --expires 24h`."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc9","heading":"0.5.15-rc9 - 2026-10-17","body":"Every client sees one live session, and codex keeps its prompt cache through a run.\n\n### Added\n\n- A client that attaches to a running session gets its live state: queued messages, pending approvals and questions, the sub-agents that are working, and the running turn. A second client opens a running session in about MS instead of 3 s.\n- Session settings live in the holder: asking, the model pick and effort set from any client, over serve or in a terminal, apply to the next request and every attached client sees them.\n\n### Changed\n\n- codex-sub sends a run over one websocket with `previous_response_id`, as codex does, and falls back to https when the socket fails. On the rivals task every request after the first now reads at least as much from the cache as the one before. A session keeps one thread, window and turn id and sends the turn-state token back.\n- A window with 450 folded sub-agents holds SIZE instead of 82: the opening chat is freed once it is drawn.\n- A memory summary over N bytes is cut at a word instead of asked again: 97 calls for 97 summaries where it took 120.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- `session.forked` names the new session in `to`, a fork is announced even when its header edit fails, and a sub-agent's fork no longer switches the session serve shows.\n- Opening a second session over serve with an asking setting no longer changes the first session's."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc8","heading":"0.5.15-rc8 - 2026-10-17","body":"A running session belongs to no window, opens fast however old it is, and the trace says who stopped what.\n\n### Added\n\n- A running session lives in a background holder that no window owns. The terminal and the desk follow it, see each other's messages at once, and closing one leaves the others running; ctrl+c with another client attached only detaches. Ten seconds after the last client closes, the holder ends the session.\n- `tofu session trace` prints a short summary of a session (turns, sub-agents and how they ended, errors, stops and who asked) with drill-down commands, and takes `--since 1h`, `--from` and `--to`, `--agent`, `--turn`, `--kind`, `--grep` and `--last`. On an 80-generation session a filtered query answers in under a second.\n- Every stop, cancel, close and park writes a trace row naming who asked (the key and screen, the serve client, a follower, the holder's grace, a crash) and what it took down; a parked sub-agent's row points at the row that parked it.\n- Every board event names its author (you, a Claude Code session, tofu's lead, a sub-agent or a hook) with its session and trace; the lead's brief, messages, a sub-agent's asks and the answers show on the ticket as a conversation.\n- `boardy.rows` over `tofu serve` sends a board's list in SIZE instead of SIZE.\n\n### Changed\n\n- Resuming an old session reads only the generations it must: on an 80-generation session with SIZE of events, `tofu --continue` reaches input in 0.43 s instead of 5.5 s, and `session.open` over serve answers in 0.47 s instead of 5.1 s.\n- Session history pages over serve come from one cached replay: under MS a page instead of about 700.\n- A message sent over serve while a turn runs is queued as a steer instead of refused; `expectedTurnId` keeps the strict refusal.\n- A stop that does not ask for everything stops only the lead and leaves running sub-agents working; `turn.stop` takes `everything` to stop them too. A second Esc no longer stops everything after a delay.\n- Memory summaries are written only when the episode view outgrows its limit: a short task makes none.\n- Memory summaries run on the session's own subscription; `memoryModel` empty means that.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- The started sub-agents are no longer drawn or sent as the lead's words."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc7","heading":"0.5.15-rc7 - 2026-10-17","body":"A board runs itself: hooks enforce how work moves, the lead plans with epics and sprints, and an audit says what is wrong.\n\n### Added\n\n- Board hooks: a YAML file in a board's `rules/`, the project's, or `~/.tofu/boardy/rules` fires `before` or `after` any board event (`ticket.create`, `ticket.move`, `ticket.assign`, `epic.create`, `sprint.close`, `triage.accept`, `question.answer`, `agent.report`, `lead.attach`, `schedule`), checks fields, a command, Jev or the sub-agent's contract, and refuses, nudges, asks you or records; an `after` hook can create, move, assign, log, notify or set. `tofu boardy rule list|show|add|edit|remove|test` and serve `boardy.rules` and `boardy.rule.*` manage them.\n- `tofu boardy init` writes starter hooks: every ticket has an epic, Jev suggests one from the open epics, review needs evidence for each acceptance line, a sub-agent's ticket left in doing moves to review with its report, and a review waiting over 2 hours tells the lead.\n- The lead has `board_rule`, `epic`, `sprint`, `milestone` and `triage` tools, `ticket_create` takes an epic and a sprint, and `ticket_ask` opens a real question. When you correct how the board is run twice, the lead adds a hook that does it and says so in one line.\n- `tofu boardy audit` names what is wrong with a board, with ticket ids; serve `boardy.audit`.\n- `tofu boardy set ID --epic E --sprint S`, and `--epic` and `--sprint` on `tofu boardy new`.\n\n### Changed\n\n- On a board with no managers the lead acts as the lead, not as you, so a hook that waits for you makes it wait.\n- A session file cut by a crash gets its next record on a new line, and the cut line is skipped."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc6-fix1","heading":"0.5.15-rc6-fix1 - 2026-10-16","body":"### Changed\n\n- A cron fire draws in the chat as one row, `cron c1 fired [expand]`, never as a message from you, whether it joins a running turn or starts one. `[expand]` or `ctrl+o` opens the full prompt under the orchestrator in the sub-agents tab.\n- Opening a session reads only the hashes of its stored blobs: on an SIZE blob file memory peaks at SIZE instead of SIZE."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc6","heading":"0.5.15-rc6 - 2026-10-16","body":"Tofu stops forgetting you and stops stalling: memory reaches the lead after every fork, your standing orders survive, and nothing waits hours on a question nobody sees.\n\n### Added\n\n- When you repeat an instruction from earlier in the session, the lead gets a note quoting both messages and keeps it with `remember`. Jev decides what counts as a repeat: 7 of 14 repeats caught on a long session, against 1 before.\n- The lead keeps its sub-agent slots filled: every report ends with a board line naming how many sub-agents run, the tickets in review and the free work, and a lead that ends a turn with free work and empty slots is checked in on once tofu is idle. Any message you send drops the check-in and runs at once.\n\n### Changed\n\n- The chat shows the conversation and one status line. The lead's own reads, edits and shell calls live under the orchestrator in the sub-agents tab and in All activity; the status line names the newest call by its `[tool#id]`. Sub-agent rows read as sentences: `[&x] finished DESK-366 and waits for your review`. `chatShowsTools` on keeps the old rows.\n- A message you send while the lead works gets an answer in one line when it needs no new work, or a line saying when it will.\n- The lead gets a fresh memory view after every fork and every `tofu --continue`, so an entry added between sessions reaches it. Every sub-agent gets the memory too.\n- Standing orders (\"always\", \"never\", \"from now on\") are carried across forks in their own section and are never dropped for newer chat. The carry counts the bytes it sends.\n- A cron fire is never read or learned as your words. A job the lead makes fires on time, and a job fires more than once while one lead turn runs.\n- Crash notices from sub-agents no longer fill the memory episodes, and your lines are merged last.\n- The gate asks you only when a call changes the harness; a read-only command is never sent to you. An unanswered ask times out after 3 minutes (`gateAskWaitSeconds`) instead of stopping the turn and every cron fire behind it.\n- Shell sift asks Jev once per shell result instead of once per chunk.\n- A spawn late in a long session starts in under MS instead of up to 20 minutes: its brief reads only the files it can place.\n- `subagents NAME` shows that sub-agent. The shell lock no longer waits on a kill or a sweep, so `subagents diagnose` answers in about MS on a SIZE log.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A spawn is checked against the ticket it names, not the first ticket the brief mentions, and a ticket assigned to the spawning session is accepted.\n- A resumed sub-agent still moves its own ticket in a new generation.\n- Reopening a session tells the lead only of sub-agents cut off just then, not every one that ever errored.\n- Every goroutine in the command line and the interface recovers from a panic and writes a crash file."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc5","heading":"0.5.15-rc5 - 2026-10-16","body":"A long session stays small: what tofu no longer needs leaves memory and disk, and closing takes milliseconds.\n\n### Added\n\n- A second tofu on the same machine that opens a session another tofu holds follows it live: it replays the session, streams the running turn, and sends its prompts, steering, Esc, approvals and question and memory answers to the holder; if the holder dies it takes the session within about MS. `tofu serve` answers `session.open` with `heldBy` and sends `turn.steerQueued` for a follower's steer.\n- One `edit` call can change several files with `edits`, all or none; every check reads every file in the call, and an empty `old_string` appends to a file. On the `bench/rivals` long edit, Sonnet's output fell from 11,290 to 6,826 tokens.\n- A sub-agent given `.` as its paths holds the whole project and nothing outside it.\n\n### Changed\n\n- A sub-agent that finishes stops the shells it started (a shell a person holds keeps running and the report names it), frees its conversation from memory until it is messaged again, and its scratch folder is removed. At 200 finished sub-agents memory fell from SIZE to SIZE.\n- Sub-agents folded in the chat and the sub-agents tab leave memory and are read back from the session when opened: at 450 sub-agents of 200 calls each, SIZE instead of 155.\n- The host redraws only sub-agents that changed: one reply at 450 sub-agents costs MS instead of 2.5.\n- `tofu serve` forgets a shell once it exits and keeps only a running shell's last SIZE: 500 shells that printed SIZE each hold SIZE instead of 540.\n- A background command that never says it is ready returns after 2 s instead of 10, and its shell is listed from its start.\n- While tofu runs, ended shell records are pruned hourly, and artifacts no live session refers to and crash files are removed after 7 days, off the start-up path. The undo store prunes hourly and keeps the last 20 turns.\n- `cron.json` is written when a job changes, not every second.\n- A session reads its stored keys once and again only after a login; the credential store is opened twice per session instead of about ten times.\n- A memory compaction on one chat reuses the prompt cache once its prompt is long enough to be cached.\n- A lead script's changed lines count against the lead's budget without a sub-agent's writes made at the same time.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- Closing tofu cancels a memory compaction cleanly and leaves nothing running or writing: close takes about MS instead of 3 s.\n- A framework rule no longer reads a path like `project\\C:\\Users\\package.json` when the task names an absolute path.\n- A sub-agent's quoted log message that mentions a git command is no longer refused as one.\n- Feed events never share a short id in very long sessions, and a failed tool call stays failed when it is read back or resumed."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc4","heading":"0.5.15-rc4 - 2026-10-16","body":"tofu survives its own crashes, cleans up after itself, and can show where a long session spends its memory.\n\n### Added\n\n- `tofu --profile` (with `--continue`, `run`, `session` or `serve`) writes a CPU profile, a heap profile and a goroutine dump every 3 minutes and at exit into a folder it prints, keeping the last 5 snapshots and the last 5 runs.\n- `tofu --temporary-project` and `tofu run --temporary-project` mark a project temporary: the next tofu to start removes its sessions and logs once it has been unused for two hours, never while a tofu has it open and never the project's own files.\n- `tofu run --thinking-summary summarized|omitted` sets the thinking body for one run without changing settings.\n- `tofu serve` answers `boardy.questions`, `boardy.answer`, `boardy.plan` and `boardy.init`, and every boardy answer carries the board's `words`.\n- A model file can set `verbosity` and `reasoning_context`, sent on the codex wire as codex sends them; `codex-sub/gpt-5.6-sol` ships with `low` and `all_turns`, which cut its median output on `bench/rivals` from 4,268 to 3,830 tokens.\n\n### Changed\n\n- The setting `oneTurnPerProject` is now `oneWorkingSessionPerProject`, and its refusal says a session is already working in the project; a settings file with the old key keeps its value.\n- A python, node or bash script the lead runs counts the source lines it changed against the lead's 200-line budget; once spent, further scripts and edits are refused, naming the scripts that spent it.\n- Sub-agents settled for over two hours fold on a timer, so a quiet session folds them too.\n- A TypeScript edit waits up to MS for the type check, so a busy machine still gets the verdict with the edit.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A crash inside a host watcher, a serve request, a shell reader, a tool, the browser, a web fetch, a search, the memory build, a hook, a board or a session store ends only that unit, with the stack in a crash file; watchers restart and requests answer with an error.\n- A refused tool call's trace line names the command it refused."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc3","heading":"0.5.15-rc3 - 2026-10-15","body":"A long session stays light: ended shells leave memory, and a reopen sends each report once.\n\n### Changed\n\n- Only running shells are held, polled and drawn. An ended shell's record and log stay on disk: `tofu shells list` and the shells screen show running shells (`none running` when there are none), and `tofu shells log <name>` still prints an ended one for 72 hours. A one-shot command that ended leaves no record.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A session with thousands of kept shells no longer grows the app by gigabytes: the shells poll read every ended shell four times a second and overlapping polls held every copy. With 10,000 kept shells the app stays near SIZE, where 0.5.15-rc2 grew past SIZE, and ctrl+c quits in about 0.1 s (`bench/flows`).\n- A reopened session no longer posts again a report the lead already read in an earlier generation."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc2","heading":"0.5.15-rc2 - 2026-10-15","body":"Sub-agents survive a crash, a restart and a long session.\n\n### Added\n\n- `tofu serve` lets a client that declares `takeover`, such as the desk app, hand a person an agent's running shell and give it back, without killing it; `tofu shells` shows it as `running, held by a person`.\n\n### Changed\n\n- Sub-agents settled for over two hours fold into one row in the sub-agents tab and the chat; a click, `enter`, `f` or a search opens them. At 450 sub-agents the app holds about SIZE instead of 334 and draws a chat frame in MS instead of 21 (`bench/longsession`).\n- A sub-agent's one-hour cap counts only its own work, not time spent waiting on the lead or on you.\n- Independent tool calls go out in one reply: tofu-gpt took 6 conversation requests instead of 11 on the `bench/rivals` Go task.\n- A wide search pages by file and shows the matching lines: on the `bench/rivals` large read, input fell to about 82k tokens with Sonnet and 86k with GPT, under omp's 97k.\n- A refused shell write names the edit or write call that does the same change: on the `bench/rivals` long edit Sonnet took 5 conversation requests instead of 16 (omp: 7).\n- A read of a missing file lists the files git knows before walking the tree: 7 s became 0.1 s in a large project, and a sub-agent's brief takes 0.26 s instead of 40.\n- A third identical read of an unchanged file says so instead of sending it again.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A sub-agent still working when tofu closed comes back errored on `tofu --continue`, and the lead is told at which step it stopped; a report it finished before the close still reaches the lead. A session from an older build lists such sub-agents as dead, not running.\n- A grant the lead gives a sub-agent mid-step no longer crashes the app (`slice bounds out of range`). A crash inside any turn ends only that turn, as errored with the stack in its trace, and the app runs on.\n- A crash in the interface turns mouse reporting and the full-screen mode off before it prints, so the terminal no longer echoes mouse moves after it."},{"version":"0.5.15-rc1","heading":"0.5.15-rc1 - 2026-10-14","body":"tofu starts, resumes and idles faster and lighter, and sends fewer tokens for the same work.\n\n### Changed\n\n- The interface draws its first screen in about MS on a fresh start and MS when resuming a 2,130-event session, against 184 and MS in 0.5.14 (`bench/startup`). It opens its credential store once instead of about twenty times, reads only what a resumed session shows, and loads the time zone and git identity beside the first frame.\n- tofu sitting idle uses about 2.4% of a core in a chat, 1.1% on the set-up screen and 0.35% as `tofu serve`, under half of 0.5.14: the input reader waits on the console instead of polling every MS, the screen redraws only when something changed, and the welcome animations share one clock (`bench/profile`).\n- Verbs start in about MS of package init instead of MS; `docs`, `changelog`, `context` and `settings` answer about 1.7x faster and `tofu usage` checks every account at once (`bench/cli`).\n- `tofu serve` answers `session.list` about 4x and `session.trace` about 2x faster, and the `boardy` verbs and `boardy.*` calls 1.7 to 2x faster on a board of 1,500 tickets, with the same output (`bench/serve`, `bench/boardy`).\n- Each request is about a fifth smaller: tool descriptions say only what a model needs before a call, and the rest arrives in the error when the case happens. A `tofu run` whose task names a few files in one folder leaves out the sub-agent text. A conversation is cached from its first message. On the `bench/rivals` Go task with Sonnet 5.5, median input fell from about 105k to 74k tokens with quality unchanged.\n- The lead may change up to 200 source lines a turn in any folder; a write counts only the lines it changes, and a file read with `cat` counts as read. On the `bench/rivals` long edit tofu takes 78 s against 141 s before (omp: 91 s).\n- `codex-sub/gpt-5.6-sol` runs without the plan tool, which took tofu-gpt from 11 requests to 7 on `bench/rivals`. A model file can say `plan: no`.\n- The `thinkingSummary` setting `omitted` now sends the thinking body Claude Code sends on claude-sub and the one codex sends on codex-sub; `summarized`, the default, sends omp's. Sonnet's thinking tokens are recorded in the session.\n- A sub-agent allocates about 35% less, and under one vCPU and SIZE tofu runs ten sub-agents at about SIZE each (`bench/minimal`).\n- A rule can carry an `unless` pattern that vetoes a match on its line; the browse rule no longer fires on a domain inside an import or module line.\n- Episode memory compacts after the answer instead of before it, and its calls reuse their own cache.\n- `tofu models reload` finds the newest Jev build and pins it (Jev 1.14 today); when the gate's calibration names an older build, it says the gate runs in shadow until it is calibrated again. The app's start-up reload only reports a newer build.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- The footer names the account that served the last request, and follows a rotation, a pick and a login.\n- A reply cut short by Esc, a closed terminal or a hangup is kept and shown as interrupted on `tofu --continue`; quitting waits at most 3 s for it.\n- On Linux and macOS a hangup quits tofu cleanly instead of killing it without saving.\n- A spent subscription rotates to the next account of the same source, asks before another source, or waits and resumes by itself.\n- A spawn asking for an effort the model lacks runs at the nearest one instead of failing.\n- A lead working alone on a small task no longer hands the whole task to a sub-agent because the spawn tool told it to.\n- 0.5.14's entry said Sonnet took 5 requests, 112k input tokens and 48 s on `bench/rivals`; that was measured on a build carrying a change 0.5.14 did not hold. This release's own numbers are above."},{"version":"0.5.14","heading":"0.5.14 - 2026-10-13","body":"A lead that never freezes, an auto mode that asks only when it matters, and tofu ahead of Claude Code on the same task.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A reply that starts several sub-agents no longer freezes the lead when a hook refuses one of them: the refused one shows its refusal and the others start. Esc while a turn is stopping sends your queued message and stops the lead; if the stop is still pending a few seconds later, Esc stops everything, and Ctrl+C then quits.\n- A sub-agent's chip shows its real name after `tofu --continue`.\n- A sub-agent resumed by a message keeps running when you press Esc.\n\n### Changed\n\n- Auto mode asks you only for what is destructive, outside the project or facing out. Reads, `--help`, a `/dev/null` redirect and a nested fixture's settings no longer ask; a sub-agent's work inside its own paths no longer goes to the lead; a choice the ask judge approves and marks reversible is taken without asking. A headless `tofu run` runs a call the gate asks about and still refuses a deny or a gate that could not answer.\n- A sub-agent's checks on its own files are never refused: `gofmt`, `rustfmt`, `cargo build`, `rtk read`, `${PIPESTATUS[n]}` and a `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=` prefix are allowed on owned paths, a command is tree-wide only when it reaches a folder the agent does not hold, and its own scratch folder is recognised in `/c/...` spelling.\n- The lead does a small task in one folder itself instead of spawning and re-reading, and answers from a clean sub-agent report. On the same Go task with Sonnet 5.5, tofu now takes 5 requests, 112k input tokens and 48 s, against Claude Code's 6, 151k and 50 s (`bench/rivals`).\n- A program's own output written to a file, such as `tofu serve --schema > schema.json`, is no longer refused as hand-written source.\n- The board rules and ticket tools load only when the project has a board.\n- `tofu run --model codex-sub/...` takes the codex wire without `--wire`, prints totals that include sub-agents, and a failing test's trace reason names the failure.\n- Each step costs less: tofu's own CPU on the benchmark task fell from 2.4 s to 1.3 s and its allocation from SIZE to SIZE, with 7 `git` processes a task where it took 18. `TOFU_PPROF=<dir>` writes CPU and heap profiles."},{"version":"0.5.13-fix1","heading":"0.5.13-fix1 - 2026-10-13","body":"A sub-agent's plan stays its own.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A sub-agent that sets a plan no longer replaces the lead's: each sub-agent keeps its own plan, the lead's requests carry the lead's, and a sub-agent sees its own plan before each of its steps under `planEveryStep`."},{"version":"0.5.13","heading":"0.5.13 - 2026-10-13","body":"A longer context, a plan before every step, and sub-agents that report together.\n\n### Added\n\n- The context ceiling is 450k tokens where it was 250k, so a session forks about half as often on a 1M-window model; the `contextCeiling` setting sends it back, and `TOFU_CONTEXT_CEILING` and `--context-ceiling` still win.\n- When the lead holds a plan, every request carries it after the cached part of the prompt, so the cache reads what it read without it; `planEveryStep` turns it off. Every step carries a phase, explore, edit, verify or report, and `tofu session trace` shows it.\n- `tofu boardy new --parent DEMO-1` makes a sub-ticket `DEMO-1-1` whose owns must sit inside its parent's; `tofu boardy show <ID> --thread` lists what was asked, answered, spawned and reported on a ticket.\n- `tofu learn` lists the jobs repeated across sessions with the same tools, how often, and what each cost.\n\n### Changed\n\n- Sub-agents that finish within a second and a half of each other reach the lead as one turn; an ask, a blocked report or a report the lead is waiting on goes at once, and a check-in never starts a lead turn of its own.\n- `tofu app` and `tofu serve` collect garbage about half as often (GOGC 200 with a 512 MiB soft limit) unless `GOGC` or `GOMEMLIMIT` is set."},{"version":"0.5.12","heading":"0.5.12 - 2026-10-13","body":"A board that asks the person in one minute, hooks that run as tofu itself, and a faster start.\n\n### Added\n\n- `tofu boardy ask <ticket> --tldr --eli5 --options \"a | b\" --recommend n --why` puts a question on a ticket, and a ticket reaches the new `needs-decision` status only with one. `tofu boardy catchup` lists every open question with its tldr, plain explanation, options and recommendation, and writes `catchup.md` for the board; the person answers there, and `tofu boardy catchup --answers` logs each answer on its ticket, clears it, and moves the ticket back.\n- `tofu boardy held <path>` names the doing ticket and glob holding a path; `tofu boardy check move` runs the same checks as the move and writes nothing; `tofu boardy list --fields` returns only the named fields; tickets carry `spec` and `size`; a board can ask for a Log of at least N characters before review and a source in every Scope.\n- `tofu guard <rule>` runs a repository's Claude Code hook rules and its git commit-message check in tofu itself, on Windows, Linux and macOS, reading the hook JSON on stdin.\n- `tofu browser profile new|list|login|stop|remove` and the `browserProfile` and `browserHeadless` settings: an agent browses on its own Chrome profile under the tofu home, logged in once, headless or not. With no profile set, the browser extension works as before.\n- `/simplify`, `/debug <symptom>` and `/hunt [where]` start a turn: the last diff with a simplify skill, a debugging skill that reproduces first, and a hunter and a skeptic followed by a referee. `/help` lists every command.\n- A sub-agent's inline code (`python -c`, `node -e`, a heredoc, a script in its scratch folder) asks the person, through the lead, with allow once, deny, always here and never here. The person sees the exact code, its hash and where it runs; it runs from the scratch folder with secret-named variables removed, and the ledger keeps a row for each ask and each run.\n- The rust-dev agent carries the gpui knowledge, and rules can name `framework: gpui-ce` from a Cargo.toml.\n\n### Changed\n\n- Every verb starts faster: `tofu version` in about MS where it took about 320, with SIZE of start-up allocation where it took 7.9.\n- The sub-agents screen allocates about SIZE a frame while thinking streams, where it allocated SIZE, with thinking shown or hidden.\n- `shell wait` waits until the command exits, up to five minutes, or until its output holds the `until` text, so one wait covers a long build.\n- A spawn writes how long each step before the sub-agent started took into the lead's trace."},{"version":"0.5.11-fix2","heading":"0.5.11-fix2 - 2026-10-13","body":"Forks stop paying for the whole conversation again, and the settings screen gets a Projects section.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A trim no longer runs right before a fork, and it only rewrites tool results near the end of the conversation, so the prompt cache survives: the request a fork makes now writes about a thousand tokens of cache where it wrote the whole conversation, 137k to 190k tokens. A session that cannot fork still trims enough to stay under its target.\n- The state an older tofu kept in a project's `.tofu` folder moves to the tofu home once, on the first open of the project, and a file already there is settled without asking: `sessions/HEAD` and cache entries keep the home's, a log day merges both, anything else keeps the old copy beside it. The warnings that repeated on every `tofu --continue` are gone.\n- An \"always\" answer to interpreter code (`python -c`, `node -e`, a heredoc, a script) covers only that exact code in that folder, and an \"always allow\" for code is never written to disk. Code fed to an interpreter on stdin or through a wrapper such as `uv run` or `env` now counts as a write tofu cannot place.\n- The settings screen and `tofu settings` have a Projects section with Boardy, Boardy flow, Scratchpad cleanup and Scratchpad size."},{"version":"0.5.11-fix1","heading":"0.5.11-fix1 - 2026-10-12","body":"A board keeps every ticket's owns.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- Boardy holds a ticket's owns only while it is in doing (or the statuses a board names in `holds` in board.toml): tickets in review, todo or done keep their owns as a record and never block each other, and two tickets in doing on the same paths are still refused, naming the holder. An owns entry may be an absolute path outside the project."},{"version":"0.5.11","heading":"0.5.11 - 2026-10-10","body":"Long sessions stay fast on the sub-agents and shells screens, and one `tofu serve` holds several sessions at once.\n\n### Added\n\n- `tofu serve` sends `account.state` when an account becomes rate limited, spent, or serving again, and `settings.changed` when a setting changes, from the desk, the command line or another window. Quota windows carry `stale` and `read_at`, and a rate-limited reading is read again when its retry time passes.\n- One `tofu serve` keeps every session it opened: a turn in one session keeps running and reporting while another session is open, every notification and status record names its session, `status.list {}` answers for all of them, and `session.close` stops tracking one.\n- `session.branch` and `tofu session branch` take `--model`, `--effort` and `--at <event>`; a side chat keeps its model and effort when it is opened again.\n\n### Changed\n\n- The sub-agents screen stays fast in long sessions: the first frame after switching to it went from about MS to under MS, and a burst of streamed thinking from many sub-agents is drawn once per frame instead of once per chunk.\n- The shells screen and its polling read only the new end of each kept shell's log: SIZE per poll instead of SIZE with 40 shells.\n- On a board with `projectManagement` boardy, the lead manages its project's boards for you, so it can create, assign and spawn for tickets without being added as a manager first.\n- `undo`, `label`, `settings.set`, `login.start` and `scratch.clean` over serve answer typed results; `query.context` with no session answers the open session.\n- Every ref `tofu serve` hands out, including messages, turns and `[&agent]`, resolves through `mention.resolve`.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- With many sub-agents reporting at once on Windows, a report or spawn result no longer fails on `session.json` being held by another reader.\n- The chat no longer drops the lead's text while a sub-agent it started has not answered yet.\n- `login.start` over serve refuses a role tofu does not know.\n- `session.turns` on a session that has recorded no turn yet answers an empty list instead of an error.\n- Boardy dates are plain days, read the same in every time zone, and `boardy lint` catches two wildcard owns in one folder."},{"version":"0.5.10-fix1","heading":"0.5.10-fix1 - 2026-10-09","body":"The first open of a project no longer copies its folder before drawing.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- The first `tofu`, `tofu --continue`, `tofu session`, `tofu serve` or `tofu run` in a project renames its old folder to the new name at once; 0.5.10 copied the whole folder first, with nothing on screen, which took minutes for a few gigabytes. A rename that fails prints one line and the old folder keeps working."},{"version":"0.5.10","heading":"0.5.10 - 2026-10-09","body":"A scratchpad per agent outside your repository, boardy for local project management, and a project folder named after the project.\n\nClose every older tofu session before the first run of this version: it copies each project's folder to its new name once, and an older tofu keeps writing the old one.\n\n### Added\n\n- A scratchpad outside the repository, under `~/.tofu/projects/<project>/scratchpad/`: each agent writes its temporary files, logs and outputs in its own folder, every process tofu starts gets `TMP`, `TEMP` and `TMPDIR` pointing there, and build caches (cargo, pycache, ruff, mypy, pytest, Go) go under it. `tofu scratch` lists the folders and leftovers, `tofu scratch clean` removes old ones, and the settings `scratchCleanupDays` and `scratchMaxGB` bound them. Agents use `scratch_path`, `scratch_share`, `scratch_list` and `scratch_read`; reading another project's `shared/` asks you once per project.\n- Boardy, local project management in markdown files: `tofu boardy init|new|list|show|move|log|lint|boards`, managers and a triage queue, hand-over between boards, board rules on create, move, widen and close, views, reports, epics, milestones and sprints. `projectManagement` set to `boardy` makes the lead and its sub-agents work from tickets with `ticket_*` tools; `boardFlow` speaks Jira or Linear words.\n- `tofu serve` answers `query.settings` with labels, kinds, choices and bounds, `query.commands`, `session.turns`, `status.list` for one session, `status.ack`, and sends `turn.account`, `shell.ready` with a port, `session.turns.updated`, plus `scratch.*` and `boardy.*`.\n\n### Changed\n\n- A sub-agent writing outside its folder, its scratch folder or the shared one is refused, including `/tmp`.\n- A project's folder under `~/.tofu/projects/` is its folder name and a short hash, such as `shop-7cd21bfb`, so two paths never share one and a long path no longer makes a long name. The first open copies the old folder and keeps it. A moved repository is offered a relink, and `tofu migrate --relink` accepts it.\n- `tofu --continue` and `tofu session resume` open the app at once with a `restoring <handle>` spinner; the resume summary is a note inside the app instead of a block printed before it.\n- `tofu session list` counts only the lead's steps; calls to the memory model show in their own `memory model` section of `tofu session trace` and no longer read as a cache break.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- A sub-agent's question stays on screen after the lead's turn ends, and a question raised while the lead is idle shows; before, the answer key went into the composer and the sub-agent waited forever.\n- `session.trace` over `tofu serve` answers for a session that used the memory model, and carries its `memory` calls."},{"version":"0.5.9-fix1","heading":"0.5.9-fix1 - 2026-10-09","body":"The app opens and answers keys in a project with hundreds of finished shells.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- `tofu` and `tofu --continue` no longer freeze in a project with more than 256 finished shells: the status board keeps the newest 256 and writes each to the terminal once, where 0.5.9 wrote every one again on every screen update and ignored keys and Ctrl+C.\n- Standing answers stay with the session and come back when it reopens.\n- A side chat's held paths hold against the lead's bash and its sub-agents.\n- Signed-in accounts stay signed in until the server ends them, and the picker uses the account used least recently first."},{"version":"0.5.9","heading":"0.5.9 - 2026-10-09","body":"Memory that keeps a project's whole conversation, a lead that asks with options instead of stopping, and everything the desk asked of `tofu serve`.\n\n### Added\n\n- **Memory in four scopes**: you and the project, each global in `~/.tofu/` or local in the repository's `.tofu/`. Jev suggests the scope on the remember card and you pick; a line that names something of yours never goes into the shared project scope. Entries in a repository carry an opaque author, never your email, and `memoryFromAllUsers` decides whether a teammate's own entries apply to you.\n- **An episode log per project**: your messages, the lead's replies and sub-agent reports, summarized as a tree whose recent lines stay whole. A fork carries it with no extra model call, and the lead can `zoom` into any line down to the original message or `recall` by pattern. `tofu memory tree`, `zoom` and `recall` read it, and `episodes` turns it off.\n- **`ask_person`**: the lead asks a question with options, a recommended one and free text. In auto it never stops the work: the recommended option stands after `askPersonWaitSeconds` and a later answer still reaches the lead.\n- **Side chats**: `tofu session branch <session> --side` opens a conversation beside the lead that reads by default (`sideChatAccess`, or the `notes` preset for `.md` and `.html`), never becomes the session `--continue` opens, and over `tofu serve` as `session.branch` and `session.access`.\n- **Program status over OSC 7501**: the app reports idle, working, blocked or done to the terminal, and `tofu serve` sends a `status` record for the lead, each sub-agent, each kept shell and each cron job, including a shell program's own report.\n- **For the desk on `tofu serve`**: the board queries (usage history, limits with burn rate, context items, skills, rule text and fires, a ledger summary, the fork tree), a `ref` on every item and `mention.resolve`, `tofu/askPerson`, the four-scope memory answers, memory views, zoom and recall, the approvals' accepted answers and standing answers.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A sub-agent's ask costs the lead one quiet answer**: `allow_here` stands for that kind of call, and a lead turn that only answers asks ends without a chat message.\n- **A sub-agent's bash outside its paths only reads**: commands that would write, delete or run code are refused with the reason, on Windows, Linux and macOS.\n- **Memory opens the session as its own message** after the system prompt, so remembering something mid-session no longer rewrites the cached prompt; a sub-agent gets only the memory lines the lead cites.\n- **A shell is announced only when it is kept** and always ends on the wire; a running one-shot no longer shows on the shells screen.\n- **Jev fails over between OpenRouter and TypeSafe** when one cannot pay, is limited or does not answer, and a Jev that cannot answer refuses in auto and asks in ask mode.\n- **Quota reads the replies tofu already gets**, shares one cache across processes and shows the last reading with its age instead of a blank row after a 429.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- Stopping a process tofu started through `Stop-Process` or `taskkill` no longer goes to Jev.\n- A cron fire no longer reads twice, and `/cron delete all` empties the book.\n- A reopened session sends a sub-agent's tool events with the agent named.\n- Memory from 0.5.8 is copied, not moved, so an older tofu still reads it."},{"version":"0.5.8","heading":"0.5.8 - 2026-10-08","body":"The lead controls its sub-agents, a message sent mid-turn goes in without stopping the work, and the desk can drive all of it over `tofu serve`.\n\n### Added\n\n- **Esc while the lead works sends the queued messages into the running turn** instead of ending it: the work so far, the sub-agents and the shells stay, and the lead answers in one line before its next tool call. Alt+S sends only the picked queued message. Each message read mid-turn shows \"read by the lead at step N\". Esc with nothing queued, or a second Esc, stops the lead as before.\n- **A command piped into grep, sed, awk, cut, tr or uniq prints each line as it comes** on the shells screen, and a bash call killed at its timeout says `hit the deadline after N s` in its result, the shells screen and the session trace.\n- **`subAgentCache`** puts sub-agents on the five minute cache while the lead keeps one hour. A sub-agent's first request caches its brief, so its second request reads it instead of paying for it again, and `tofu session trace` shows each request's cache lifetime and a cache breaks section naming where a request stopped matching the one before it.\n- **`tofu serve` covers what the desk needs**: a typed `session.list` with running and last activity, `session.state`, `session.set`, images and a model on `turn.send`, `turn.sendNow` and the `turn.steered` read event, a lead-only stop, `turn.unsteer`, `shell.run`, `session.compact`, paged `session.history`, every `query.*` typed, memory add, edit and remove, reload, learn, rules and agents writes with an undo line, `session.info`, `session.trace`, `session.find`, and `login.key` and `login.logout`. `tofu docs serve-methods` lists every method.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **The lead grants, revokes and replaces a sub-agent's paths**, stops the sub-agents and windows it started without asking, and closes a window it opened by name when every process of that name runs in tofu's own shells. Grants survive a restart, each sub-agent gets its own scratch folder, and a long ask is capped.\n- **The lead checks a sub-agent's work before taking it**, by default. `tofu settings set verifySubAgents false` turns it off.\n- **A session keeps the system prompt and tools it started with** until it forks or is cleared, so its cache is not rewritten mid-conversation.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **A request past the context ceiling is refused before it is sent**, instead of going out over the limit.\n- **Several sub-agents spawned at once no longer fail with \"Access is denied\"** on Windows.\n- **A shell tofu cannot list no longer leaves a child running** or its log locked.\n- **A resumed session no longer shows tofu's own notes as your messages.**"},{"version":"0.5.7-fix2","heading":"0.5.7-fix2 - 2026-10-08","body":"### Added\n\n- **`tofu serve` says who started a turn.** `turn.started` and `message.user` carry `origin`: the person, a cron job with its schedule, or an agent, live and in a reopened session. `session.list` rows and `session.updated` carry `lastAt`, the last time anything was recorded in the session.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **Update notices no longer appear in the chat.** A fresh session shows them under the welcome art, and a running session at the right of the status row above the composer."},{"version":"0.5.7-fix1","heading":"0.5.7-fix1 - 2026-10-08","body":"### Added\n\n- **`tofu serve` takes `session.rename {session, name}`**, which renames every generation of the session as `tofu session rename` does and answers with `session.updated` carrying the new name and handle."},{"version":"0.5.7","heading":"0.5.7 - 2026-10-07","body":"A long conversation keeps its name, its work and its cache.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A conversation keeps one name across forks**, `/compact` and account moves, shown as `name#tag.N` with the number rising. `tofu session <name>` shows the whole family with its age and active time, `tofu session find <name> --tool bash` searches every generation, and names from older sessions still resolve. Hooks see the family id as `session_id`.\n\n- **When a conversation crosses its budget, tofu shrinks results the model has already read before it forks.** A fork carries the working state the model wrote and points at every call it read; the `lookup` tool brings any of them back.\n\n- **Messages typed while the lead works wait in one queue** above the composer and reach the lead as one message at its next step; none is dropped, and ctrl+x takes one back before the lead reads it.\n\n- **A sub-agent sent back or messaged again reuses its cached conversation** instead of writing it to the cache a second time.\n\n### Added\n\n- **`read` shows the model a png, jpeg, gif or webp as a picture**, shrunk to 1568 px when larger, for the lead and sub-agents.\n\n- **`tofu serve` tells a client its cron jobs** (`query.cron`, `cron.updated`, `cron.command`) and sends `quota.updated` as soon as a session opens and every 5 minutes."},{"version":"0.5.6-fix3","heading":"0.5.6-fix3 - 2026-10-07","body":"### Added\n\n- **tofu updates itself.** The app looks up the latest release at most once an hour, installs a newer one in the background and says `tofu X is installed · restart to use it`. `tofu settings set autoUpdate false` leaves only `tofu X is out · tofu update installs it`. A session left open also says so when any newer tofu is put on disk.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **Sub-agents above the composer fold into one line**, for example `(13) agents waiting for an answer · (2) agents running bash`; the sub-agents screen keeps the per-agent detail.\n\n- **Only a question open right now counts as waiting.** A sub-agent whose write was refused by its owns ends finished, needing context, instead of waiting for an answer forever."},{"version":"0.5.6-fix2","heading":"0.5.6-fix2 - 2026-10-07","body":"### Fixed\n\n- **Typing a message never offers to keep it as memory**, whatever it says. Memory is added with `tofu memory add`, with `/remember <what>`, which keeps it at once, or by the lead's card titled `[&orchestrator] wants to add a project memory`, with tab switching to a global one.\n\n- **A memory is one short rule**: one line of at most N bytes, stating the rule itself. The lead's `remember` tool and `tofu learn` refuse one that names or describes you.\n\n- **`tofu changelog` orders a fix release after its base version**, so a `-fix` entry reads once and is not shown as unread again."},{"version":"0.5.6-fix1","heading":"0.5.6-fix1 - 2026-10-07","body":"### Fixed\n\n- **The sub-agents, file edits and shells screens stay responsive on a long session.** On a session of 117 sub-agents and 9,400 events, scrolling the activity feed to its oldest card took 2.7 s a frame and now takes MS; with sub-agents working, every screen took about MS a frame and now takes 6 to MS."},{"version":"0.5.6","heading":"0.5.6 - 2026-10-07","body":"tofu remembers what you tell it, learns from your sessions, and lets the lead run its sub-agents properly.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **Your messages survive every fork word for word.** The carry into a new session lists what you said in this line of sessions, so a correction made before a fork still holds after it.\n\n- **CLAUDE.md is sent once, in the system prompt**, not with every turn and sub-agent report: the first message of a turn started by a report went from SIZE to SIZE.\n\n- **The lead runs a next step it can run instead of offering it**, and it no longer ends a reply to you with a verdict line.\n\n### Added\n\n- **`tofu learn`.** It reads your sessions for a correction you made in two or more of them, checks whether your earlier words were in the request when the mistake came back, and proposes at most five memory entries, rules or upstream drafts. `tofu learn apply <n>` writes one; an upstream draft describes what happened without your quotes and is never sent. `--local` keeps everything on your machine; the `learn` setting lets it label with Jev and word each proposal with your lead model.\n\n- **`tofu memory` and the app's offer card.** Type `remember: ...` or `/remember ...`, pick for every project or this one, and the lead reads it in every later session. `tofu memory` lists what is kept, in your words; `tofu memory remove <id>` forgets it. \"also remember ...\" anywhere in a message gets the card too, with yes, no or always. The lead can offer an entry with its `remember` tool. Every save shows as `[memory#id]` in the chat and in `tofu session trace`. `/memory` removes or edits an entry. The `memory` setting turns it off, and `autoMemory` stops the asking, which also happens once you accept 7 of your first 10 offers.\n\n- **The lead controls its sub-agents.** `subagents` lists the paths each one holds, and with a name reads one's conversation or shows what it is doing now. `message` with `do` stops, kills (its shells too), releases or backs one up, and `from` resumes one from a backup.\n\n- **Two hook events only tofu has.** `GateVerdict` runs after the gate decides on a call and can turn an ask into allow or deny, or a deny into ask, never a deny into allow. `SubagentSpawn` runs before a sub-agent starts and can refuse it or narrow its owns, never widen them. See `tofu docs hooks`.\n\n- **`tofu session trace` lists every hook run** with its event, call, exit code, time, decision and stderr, and names the relaxation that let a call over `risk_ask_at` run.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A sub-agent's row says what it is doing:** \"waiting for the orchestrator's answer\", \"running bash, 12m\" or \"building, 12m\". It says \"stalled\" only when no output, step or request has moved for the new `subAgentWatchSeconds` setting (default 600).\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **A resumed chat draws each sub-agent report as a report row**, never as something you typed.\n\n- **`tofu session trace` on a continued session lists the sub-agents that kept working in the session before it**, marked with the session they were recorded in.\n\n- **`tofu --continue` opens in under a second on a long chain of sessions**: 0.9 s where it took 12 s on a chain of 21 sessions with 84 sub-agents. Each session file is read once at open.\n\n- **A continued or resumed conversation over the context target forks before its first request**, instead of sending the whole history first.\n\n- **A running command shows its output as it prints.** Every bash is on the shells screen from its first second, the chat shows its last line, and the screen keeps updating while no turn runs. A log a script writes after a `cd` is found, a log left from an earlier run is not shown, python is unbuffered, and a command piped into `tail`, `head`, `sort` or `grep` says why its output is empty. `shell logs`, `shell wait` and `tofu shells` say how long a shell ran and when it last printed. `tofu serve` shell events no longer skip or repeat output.\n\n- **After a restart, earlier sub-agents hold no paths**, so a spawn on their files starts instead of being refused, and a refused spawn now reads as failed. A resumed sub-agent carries only its conversation since its latest fork.\n\n- **Every message shows the id it was recorded under**, the lead's messages and sub-agent reports included. Type `[message#id]` and the lead quotes that message, across forks and `--continue`; `tofu session trace` lists the same ids.\n\n- **A resumed chat keeps each message's own time.** A hook-trust prompt asks again when the hooks change, and never shares its keys with an older ask. An image pasted before a fork, or while sub-agents run, reaches the model. Shell names stay unique across `--continue`, and `tofu shells` lists finished shells for 72 hours.\n\n- **`/compact`, `/new` and `/undo` while the lead waits on sub-agents** say so and run when the turn ends. A sub-agent waiting on the lead reads \"waiting for the orchestrator's answer\", and `subagents diagnose` shows a shell's last 10 lines.\n\n- **Shift+Enter adds a line past the eighth.** The input stops growing at 8 rows and scrolls; before, every line after the eighth was joined onto it.\n\n- **`tofu session trace` names what let an ask run**: `allowed by gatePrompt auto`, the person, the orchestrator, or a GateVerdict hook that changed the verdict. A forked session's carried calls show their verdict, result and the session they came from.\n\n- **`subagents read` and `do backup` on a running sub-agent give its conversation so far**, and the SubagentSpawn hook gets the sub-agent's task.\n\n- **`tofu why --last 5000` finishes in about 4 s** instead of not finishing in 2 minutes.\n\n- **A PreToolUse hook that asks before a sub-agent's call asks the lead**, as the gate's ask does, instead of refusing the call.\n\n- **A finished sub-agent call no longer reads as open**, so a MS write no longer shows as \"stalled write, open 22m\".\n\n- **`SessionEnd` hooks fire when `tofu drive` exits**, and `SessionStart` fires with source `compact` after a compaction."},{"version":"0.5.5","heading":"0.5.5 - 2026-10-06","body":"Sub-agents you can trust across turns and resumes, and config the model cannot change alone.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **`--continue` and `/resume` restore the session's sub-agents.** `subagents` lists the ones that ran before the resume, with how each ended, and `message` can resume a finished or parked one with its conversation.\n\n- **A `write`, `edit` or `bash` call that changes tofu's settings, the hooks files it reads, or the hook trust file waits for you**, in auto mode too, and a sub-agent's is refused.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **`ping` runs as asked, without rtk.** rtk's ping filter garbled accented output on Windows and cut the reply lines.\n- **A link in the chat no longer leaves an underline running to the screen's edge.**\n\n- **Sub-agents spawned after earlier ones each get their own report row.** A new turn's spawns no longer take the names of sub-agents from earlier turns, so stopped sub-agents show as parked and old reports are not drawn twice.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A sub-agent that only runs a command, reads or researches is spawned without owns** and starts at once. Any write or edit it tries is refused with the reason, so the lead no longer invents placeholder files to start one."},{"version":"0.5.4","heading":"0.5.4 - 2026-10-06","body":"Sub-agents that ask the orchestrator, forks at the right point, long builds in the background, and a trace that keeps everything.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **\"Thinking\" shows only while the lead's model thinks.** An open turn where only sub-agents work, or the lead writes, says \"working\".\n\n- **A long command moves to a background shell instead of being killed.** A bash call still running after 30 s returns with the shell's name and its output so far, and the command keeps running. `shell wait` waits for it to end. Sub-agents get the `shell` tool wherever they get `bash`. A shell's row shows the tail of a log file the command names.\n\n- **A fork happens near the target, and keeps the steps the model was in.** A ceiling set with `TOFU_CONTEXT_CEILING` or `--context-ceiling` used to fork at 25% of it; it now forks at 80%, as a ceiling taken from the model's window does. A fork keeps the newest step whole when it fits, and the trace records the count that decided it.\n\n### Added\n\n- **`tofu serve --stdio`** lets another program drive tofu over JSON-RPC on standard input and output (`tofu.host/1`). It sends typed items with session, turn, agent and seq, carries approvals when asking is on, and refuses a second writer with `session.busy`. `tofu serve --schema` prints the schema.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A sub-agent never asks you.** When Jev would ask about a sub-agent's call, the ask goes to the orchestrator, which answers allow or deny with the verdict in hand. The sub-agent waits up to 5 minutes for it.\n\n### Added\n\n- **A second app on a session another tofu is writing opens read only** and fires no cron job, so a loop fires once per interval however many apps are open.\n- **`oneTurnPerProject`**, on by default, refuses a turn while another session in the same project runs one. Turn it off to run several sessions in one repository at once.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **A stored key split across two streamed pieces of a reply is masked.**"},{"version":"0.5.3","heading":"0.5.3 - 2026-10-06","body":"Sub-agents you can follow and stop, hooks, and auto mode.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **Ctrl+C with the lead idle and sub-agents working asks first**: \"this will stop 2 sub-agents, press Ctrl+C again to confirm\". A second press within 3 s stops them; otherwise nothing stops. Ctrl+C while the lead works still stops only the lead, at once.\n- **A sub-agent whose tool call has been open past the longest bash deadline shows as stalled**, with the call and how long it has been open.\n- **A sub-agent's report that arrives while the lead is requesting is drawn**, once, after the lead's words. It used to be lost.\n\n- **While the lead's sub-agents work, the app says \"waiting on N sub-agents\"** with a live count, instead of \"cooked for\". \"Thinking\" shows only when the lead's own model answers, not while it waits on a request or runs spawns, and a sub-agent's stats no longer rename the lead's model.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **Auto mode is the default.** Jev decides at every gate and the work does not stop for you: a call it would ask about runs and is recorded, and a call it denies is refused. `tofu settings set gatePrompt ask` makes it wait for you. A hook that asks, a rule override, and the model changing a setting still ask you in both modes.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **A stored key is masked in every event tofu sends to the interface**, not only in tool calls, results, failures and asks.\n\n### Added\n\n- **Hooks.** Claude Code's and codex's hooks run under tofu as they are, read from `.claude/settings.json` and `~/.claude/settings.json`, plus tofu's own `.tofu/hooks.json`. PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStop, SessionStart and SessionEnd fire for the lead and every sub-agent. A project's hooks run only after you trust them once, and are asked about again when they change. `tofu hooks` lists every hook, its source, its trust and its last result."},{"version":"0.5.2","heading":"0.5.2 - 2026-10-06","body":"Faster handoffs and a frontend that can trust what it is sent.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **A `library/` folder at the root of a repository is no longer read as tofu's rules.** A project's own library now lives in `.tofu/library/`.\n- **A session open for writing is locked.** A second tofu on the same session gets a busy, read-only view and never writes to it.\n\n- **A key typed into a prompt is masked in `session.json` too**, and in sessions converted by `tofu migrate`, as it already was in `events.jsonl`.\n- **Dialogs in a Windows 10 console draw in place.** `/keys`, ctrl+p and the model picker no longer leave stray text at the left edge or push their title out of the box.\n\n### Added\n\n- **A prompt starting with `!` runs as a shell command** in the project, with no model call. The chat shows its output, keys masked, and the next prompt carries it to the model. Esc stops it.\n- **Ctrl+P searches every prompt you sent**, across sessions and projects. Enter puts the prompt in the composer without sending it.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A reply that only starts sub-agents ends the lead's turn**, with no extra request to announce them. Sub-agents started in one reply are named in the order the reply lists them.\n- **A frontend sub-agent carries only the rules its task touches.** A rule can declare `touches:`, and a sub-agent working on something else does not get it. About SIZE less per frontend sub-agent request.\n- **The lead's prompt carries rules about what to build, not how to write it.** Rules for writing, testing and building code reach only the sub-agent that writes it, unless the lead runs alone."},{"version":"0.5.1","heading":"0.5.1 - 2026-10-05","body":"Setup by role and undo.\n\n### Added\n\n- **Cron, loops and goals.** `/loop 10m <prompt>` repeats a prompt, `/goal <prompt> --until \"<command>\"` keeps working until the command passes, and `/cron` makes, lists, edits, pauses and deletes jobs. Every change to a job is kept as a version with its reason, and the lead can change a job under the `cron_edits` rule.\n- **`/compact`** shrinks old tool results to a handle between turns, and the shrink survives a restart.\n- **`/resume`** opens a picker of this project's sessions, and `/resume <name>` resumes one directly.\n- **`/keys`** lists every key the app answers to.\n- **`tofu undo [N]` and `/undo [N]`** put back the files the last turns changed, including changes made through bash. A file you edited since is left alone unless `--force`, and `--dry-run` shows what would change.\n- **Ctrl+G** opens the prompt in `$VISUAL` or `$EDITOR`.\n- **A dropped or pasted image path** attaches the image.\n- **Ctrl+V on Linux and macOS** reads the clipboard: `wl-paste`, `xclip` or `xsel` on Linux, `pbpaste` and `osascript` on macOS.\n- **`fetch` reads a long page 300 lines at a time**, with `offset` and `limit`, from one request.\n- **`write` takes `append: true`.**\n- **`tofu rules index --role orchestrator|sub-agent`** shows the rules each one gets.\n- **The drive's `requests` step** prints each request's tool count, tools hash and tool choice.\n- **`search` returns the whole function, method, class or type in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python and Rust**, as it does in Go, so the model does not read the file again.\n- **The lead gets a check on each running sub-agent** every `subAgentCheckSeconds`, 30 minutes by default: its steps, the files it changed, its gate, its last tool and its cost. tofu writes it with no model call.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A first start with nothing set up opens a two-step setup screen**: pick the language model (Claude subscription, Codex subscription or a Meta key), then the classifier (OpenRouter or TypeSafe key). A key is typed into the screen and shown by its shape. The chat opens when both are done.\n- **`tofu login` takes a role**: `tofu login llm claude-sub|codex-sub|meta`, `tofu login classifier openrouter|typesafe`, `tofu login search brave`. The old forms exit 2 and name the new one. `tofu logout <role> <provider>` removes what a login stored. While you type or paste a key, the field shows its shape (prefix, last four, length) and never the key itself. `tofu login --status` groups by role. Breaking: in `--json`, `role` is now `llm`, `classifier` or `search`.\n- **The lead no longer re-checks a sub-agent's work by default.** It takes a finished report as the result unless the report says something failed, and a clean report ends the turn with no tool call. `tofu settings set verifySubAgents true` or `tofu rules restore verify_sub_agents` turns the check back on.\n- **A turn that fills the context window** shrinks its oldest tool results and asks once more, instead of ending.\n- **The fork point follows the model's window**: 144,000 tokens on a 200k model, where it was 63,000.\n- **An empty answer, or a stream cut by an overloaded server, is retried once.**\n- **An OAuth refresh survives Esc**, and a 401 on a token that looks fresh renews it and sends once more.\n- **A turn is warned before its step cap**, and its last step must answer. A sub-agent stops after an hour.\n- **Bash** keeps a timed-out command's output, holds tofu's keys out of the command's environment, sets `AI_AGENT=tofu`, never waits on a git prompt, and decodes a Windows console code page.\n- **`edit` keeps CRLF and a BOM.** A refused edit names the lines to read instead of pasting the file. A partial read covers only the lines read.\n- **`write` over an existing file writes in place**, so it keeps the mode and a symlink, and works while another process reads the file. A write that replaces code with a placeholder such as `// ... rest unchanged` is refused.\n- **A path whose link leads outside the project is refused**, and `glob` and `search` skip folder links.\n- **`glob`** takes double-star patterns and `{a,b}`. **`search`** shows a match on a very long line, skips files over SIZE, and goes on past a file it cannot read.\n- **A long tool result is stored whole**, so `artifact_fetch` can read its middle.\n- **The model picker** never offers Fable, opens on the model in use, and keeps its header in cmd and Git Bash.\n- **A plain cmd window** shows colour instead of raw escape codes, and tofu leaves the console's code page as it found it.\n- **A library sub-agent** gets the skills its definition names.\n- **`tofu doctor`** reports the shell sift the way a run uses it.\n\n### Removed\n\n- **The `compaction` setting**, which changed nothing."},{"version":"0.5.0","heading":"0.5.0 - 2026-10-05","body":"The first public release: install with one command on Windows, Linux or macOS, and a lead that spends far fewer tokens for the same work.\n\n### Added\n\n- **Install scripts and `tofu update`.** `install.sh` for Linux and macOS and `install.ps1` for Windows install the latest release into `~/.local/bin` after checking its checksum. `tofu update` replaces the binary with the latest release, and `tofu update --check` only says whether one exists.\n- **Releases from the `release` branch**, built for Windows, Linux and macOS on amd64 and arm64.\n- **The browser relay on Linux and macOS.** `tofu browser install` registers tofu with Chrome, Chromium, Brave and Edge. `tofu doctor` gains a browser section that says, per browser, whether tofu can reach it.\n- **Rule overrides.** `tofu rules off` and `tofu rules add` take `--reason`. `tofu rules overrides` lists every override, and `tofu rules restore` removes one. When a rule blocks what you asked for, tofu names the rule, gives its reason, and asks: 1 this project, 2 everywhere, 3 no.\n- **A page check in one call.** `browser_do` takes a list of steps. Each step can check focus, an attribute, a name, the url, text, or computed style, and can turn reduced motion on. `tofu browser batch` runs the same list from a file.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **Shell output through rtk by default**, when rtk is installed. Background, piped and redirected commands run as written, and `use: off` in a `tools/shell/proxy.yaml` turns it off. `tofu doctor` says whether rtk was found.\n- **The lead carries less.** It gets the design rules that shape its brief, not the rules for how code is written. Tools a project cannot use are dropped, and a sub-agent loads its references when it needs them. The lead skips its own check pass after a single sub-agent's clean report whose checks passed.\n- **The gate reads the project's own checks**: a check run through rtk, or the project's `typecheck` or `test` script, counts. A sub-agent is judged only on errors in the files it owns. In a Vue or Svelte project, the typecheck tool runs `vue-tsc` or `svelte-check`.\n- **Tabs tofu opened close** when the run, the sub-agent or the app that opened them ends.\n\n### Removed\n\n- The old unused update check in `internal/update`."},{"version":"0.5.0-rc-fix24","heading":"0.5.0-rc-fix24 - 2026-10-03","body":"Tabs tofu opens close when it is done with them, and a frontend rule that measurably changes what the agent writes.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **Tabs tofu opened in Chrome close when the run ends**, and a browser sub-agent's tabs close when it finishes. In the interface they close when the app quits. A person's own tab is never closed. `tofu run` now cancels its turn on the first Ctrl+C so this still happens; a second Ctrl+C ends it at once.\n- **`fe_url_state` puts history first**: a filter, tab, sort or page change pushes a history entry and a search replaces it, so Back returns the view before."},{"version":"0.5.0-rc-fix23","heading":"0.5.0-rc-fix23 - 2026-10-03","body":"A library per language and per frontend framework, each rule tied to the check that catches it.\n\n### Added\n\n- **go-dev and py-dev**, sub-agents for Go and Python beside ts-dev and rust-dev. go-dev reads go.mod and the project's lint config and finishes on `go vet` and `go test`. py-dev reads pyproject.toml and finishes on `ruff check` and `pytest`, through the project's own runner. Each comes with rules naming the vet analyzer, linter or ruff code that checks them, and four references.\n- **Frontend rules for every framework**: motion, interaction, forms, accessibility, performance and layout, each naming the stylelint, axe, a11y lint or browser check that catches it. A project that has its own components never ships the browser's own widgets: no `alert`, `confirm` or `prompt`, no native date, time or colour pickers, no `title` tooltips, and no native `<select>` when it ships its own.\n- **React, Svelte and Vue rules** that reach only their own projects: React effects and purity checked by eslint-plugin-react-hooks, Svelte 5 runes and SvelteKit checked by the Svelte compiler and svelte-check, Vue's Composition API checked by eslint-plugin-vue and vue-tsc.\n- **A `framework:` key for rules**, read from package.json, including per app in a monorepo. `framework:` and `language:` take a list. `tofu rules index` names the framework that made a rule fire.\n- **A Rust rule for input-depth recursion**: a loop over an explicit stack, or a depth limit.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A gate check counts through a runner or a project script**: `uv run pytest`, `python -m pytest`, `make test` whose recipe runs `go test`.\n- **A gate failure is a real failure**: a typecheck that finds an error and a test run with a failure send the sub-agent back. A project with no tests is not held to a test check.\n- **A sub-agent sent back stays one sub-agent**: one line in the chat saying \"sent back: test did not run\", and a report that says \"sent back once\" instead of \"escalating\".\n- **`scope:` on a rule matches the paths a sub-agent owns.**\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **The browser relay hands over to a newly installed tofu**, so the extension updates without `tofu browser install`."},{"version":"0.5.0-rc-fix22","heading":"0.5.0-rc-fix22 - 2026-10-02","body":"A Rust sub-agent, and sub-agents that are held to their own checks.\n\n### Added\n\n- **rust-dev**, a sub-agent for Rust. It reads Cargo.toml, the toolchain and the project's own gate first, and finishes on `cargo clippy` and a scoped `cargo test`. Thirteen Rust rules come with it, each naming the clippy lint that checks it, and four references: verification, unsafe, errors and ownership, async.\n- **An agent definition can name its gate**, `gate:` in its front matter. ts-dev's is `typecheck, test` and rust-dev's is `cargo clippy, cargo test`. A sub-agent that changed a file in its language is sent back until every check in its gate ran after its last edit and passed.\n- **`tool_pick`**, the tool guidance every call carries, is now a shipped rule. `tofu rules list` shows it, and a project can switch it off or replace it. It names the pairs explicitly: edit over `sed -i`, glob over find, search over grep, read over cat, and the right checks for TypeScript and Rust.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A sub-agent changes source with edit or write.** A shell command that writes a source file, such as `sed -i`, `perl -pi`, a redirect or `cp`, is refused with the file named. Formatters, temp files and lockfiles are unchanged.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **A tab opened with `+` joins tofu's group only when you were in it.** From a tab outside the group it opens outside, as Chrome would without tofu."},{"version":"0.5.0-rc-fix21","heading":"0.5.0-rc-fix21 - 2026-10-02","body":"The lead knows what its sub-agents are doing, and the screen stops dropping text.\n\n### Added\n\n- **The lead lists its sub-agents.** A `subagents` tool beside `spawn` and `message` gives each sub-agent's state, how long it has run, its steps, its effort and the last tool it called, without waiting for any of them. Asked whether a sub-agent still runs, the lead checks instead of guessing.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **The qa agent runs `test` and `typecheck`** on the warm runners instead of vitest and tsc through bash.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **A line under the chat no longer loses its middle** in cmd.exe and PowerShell. With no TERM set, tofu now draws for xterm-256color and keeps the colour profile it detected. A TERM you set is left alone."},{"version":"0.5.0-rc-fix20","heading":"0.5.0-rc-fix20 - 2026-10-02","body":"Sub-agents work in the background and the lead stays with you, and a large TypeScript project answers in seconds.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A sub-agent runs in the background.** `spawn` returns at once, the lead's turn ends on its own terms, and the sub-agent keeps working. When it finishes, its report starts a new lead turn, drawn in the chat as `⟩ report [&name] finished`.\n- **You can talk to the lead while sub-agents work.** A message typed while only sub-agents run starts a lead turn at once. One typed mid-turn reaches the lead at its next step.\n- **The lead can message or stop a sub-agent from an earlier turn.** `message` reaches a running sub-agent at its next step, and resumes one that has ended with its conversation. `message` with `stop` parks one sub-agent and leaves the others running.\n- **Esc and the first ctrl+c stop only the lead's turn.** Sub-agents keep running until they finish, the lead stops them, or tofu quits.\n- **The header clock counts the whole session line** and no longer restarts when a session continues into a fork.\n- **`subAgentsPerTurn` now limits sub-agents running at once.** The key is unchanged.\n- **The lead starts each sub-agent at low effort** and settles the open choices in the brief. It raises the effort when a sub-agent fails the same check twice, returns work it would not accept, or breaks its rules.\n\n### Added\n\n- **A `typecheck` tool on a warm TypeScript checker,** started with the session. An edit on a large project returns before its check.\n- **A `test` tool on a warm vitest runner** per package. Given a source file, it runs the test beside it (`ls.ts` runs `ls.test.ts`). A runner that misses its deadline is replaced and does not hold the next call.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **The shells screen and `tofu shells log` show a log whose first line is blank,** such as `pnpm dev`.\n- **Owns accept a TanStack route name** like `routes/components/$slug.tsx`, and a path with `..` that stays inside the project.\n- **A sub-agent's shell writes to `/tmp` reach the real temp directory.** A write or edit tool call on `/tmp/x` is refused rather than creating `tmp/x` inside the project, for the lead too.\n- **A first search in a large repository answers in under a second.**\n- **An owned directory named without a trailing slash owns the files inside it.**"},{"version":"0.5.0-rc-fix19","heading":"0.5.0-rc-fix19 - 2026-09-30","body":"### Fixed\n\n- **The browser sub-agent starts when `browser` is set to read.** It gets the tools read mode offers and leaves out the ones only drive mode has. A sub-agent that names a tool tofu has never heard of is still refused.\n- **`browserCursor` is listed in the settings docs.**"},{"version":"0.5.0-rc-fix18","heading":"0.5.0-rc-fix18 - 2026-09-30","body":"A browser that finishes the task on sites it was never tuned on, and a motion capture that says what blinks.\n\n### Added\n\n- **`tofu browser motion capture <scenario.json>`** records takes of an interaction, frames and a per-paint trace, into `~/.tofu/motion/<take id>/`. With no `watch` list it watches every visible element and prints **What blinked**: each element that changed and changed back, by selector, role and name, with its time, duration, values and frames. The same report reaches the agent through `browser_motion`.\n\n### Changed\n\n- **A page answers once it is useful** and later changes arrive with the next result, so a browsing turn waits far less.\n- **Each act step names where it went:** the url it reached, an `expect_after` check that held, and what a select, fill or checkbox now reads.\n- **A click lands on the largest visible part of its target**, and falls back to the element's own `click()` when the mouse misses.\n- **A site recipe is learned from the url** of a finished task and given to the browser sub-agent on the next visit.\n- **A start url appears in the brief only when the task names one.**\n\n### Fixed\n\n- **A password fill never shows or sends its value.** The act line gives its length only.\n- **An act that times out says which step and after how long**, reconnects, and the next act works.
